subject: social_studies
name: Social Studies Concept Graph
description: Hierarchical representation of social studies concepts K-6 aligned with NCSS standards

community_culture.name: Community and Culture
community_culture.description: Understanding families, communities, and cultural diversity

geography.name: Geography
geography.description: Spatial thinking, maps, places, and human-environment interaction

history.name: History
history.description: Understanding past, change over time, and historical thinking

economics.name: Economics
economics.description: Economic concepts, decision making, and resources

geography_pathway.name: Geographic Literacy Pathway
geography_pathway.description: Developing spatial thinking and map skills

american_history_pathway.name: American History Pathway
american_history_pathway.description: Understanding U.S. history from indigenous peoples to independence

K-2.focus: Self, family, school, community, basic geography, rules
social_studies_skills: Identify self in relation to family and community
Understand rules and why they matter

3-6.focus: Expanding horizons: communities, states, nation, world, history, government
social_studies_skills: Read and interpret maps with multiple features
Make connections across time and place

theme_1.name: Culture
theme_1.k2_focus: Own culture and other cultures in community
theme_1.36_focus: Cultural diversity in U.S. and world, cultural contributions

theme_2.name: Time, Continuity, and Change
theme_2.description: Understanding past and how it relates to present
theme_2.k2_focus: Personal history, family traditions, change over time
theme_2.36_focus: Historical eras, cause and effect, multiple perspectives

theme_4.name: Individual Development and Identity
theme_4.k2_focus: Personal characteristics, roles in family and school
theme_4.36_focus: How individuals develop, factors shaping identity

theme_5.name: Individuals, Groups, and Institutions
theme_5.36_focus: Government institutions, social institutions, their purposes

theme_6.name: Power, Authority, and Governance
theme_6.k2_focus: Rules, authority figures, why we need rules
theme_6.36_focus: Government structure, democracy, rights and responsibilities

theme_7.name: Production, Distribution, and Consumption
theme_7.k2_focus: Needs vs. wants, jobs people do
theme_7.36_focus: Economic systems, supply and demand, trade

theme_8.name: Science, Technology, and Society
theme_8.k2_focus: Technology in daily life, simple tools
theme_8.36_focus: Technological change, impacts on society and environment

theme_10.name: Civic Ideals and Practices
theme_10.k2_focus: Being a good citizen, helping others, following rules
theme_10.36_focus: Democratic values, civic participation, rights and responsibilities

location.name: Location
location.relative: Position relative to other places (near, far, next to)

place.name: Place
place.description: Physical and human characteristics that make locations unique

human_environment_interaction.name: Human-Environment Interaction
human_environment_interaction.description: How people affect and are affected by environment

movement.name: Movement
movement.description: How people, goods, and ideas move

chronological_thinking.name: Chronological Thinking
chronological_thinking.k2: Yesterday, today, tomorrow; days, months, years
chronological_thinking.36: Timelines, eras, periods, BC/AD, sequence of events

historical_comprehension.name: Historical Comprehension
historical_comprehension.k2: Retell stories from past, identify who, what, where, when
historical_comprehension.36: Analyze historical narratives, identify central question, evidence

historical_analysis.name: Historical Analysis and Interpretation
historical_analysis.k2: Compare past and present, identify change
historical_analysis.36: Compare different stories about event, consider multiple perspectives, distinguish fact from fiction

historical_research.name: Historical Research
historical_research.k2: Ask questions about past, use photos and artifacts
historical_research.36: Formulate historical questions, obtain historical data from sources

historical_decision_making.name: Historical Issues-Analysis and Decision-Making
historical_decision_making.k2: Identify problem in story, suggest solution
historical_decision_making.36: Identify issues and problems in past, analyze interests and values, propose alternative solutions
